name: CausalBench
description: CausalBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the causal reasoning capabilities of large language models across textual, mathematical, and coding domains. It assesses causal understanding from four perspectives—cause-to-effect, effect-to-cause, and both with interventions—ensuring models demonstrate genuine causal reasoning rather than guessing.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has attracted interest for testing genuine causal reasoning across text, math, and code, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Benchmark covers multiple causal reasoning perspectives and domains; publicly available on HuggingFace.
